question: Is our webhook still disabled? If so, please turn it back on.

model.source: scripted: the replies a capable model gives, written to show the whole loop (the local gpt-oss-20b this example was run against enabled the webhook but did not check it again)

replies.text: Yes: wh_31c9 had been disabled since 30 September at 15:58 UTC, after 50 deliveries in a row timed out after 10 seconds. I turned it back on and checked it again: it is active, with its failure count reset. Fernway disables a webhook after 50 consecutive failures, so make sure your endpoint answers with a 2xx status within 10 seconds, or it will be disabled again [help:webhooks@2#2].
